2 import fs from 'node:fs';
3 import path from 'node:path';
4 import crypto from 'node:crypto';
5 import { HaltError } from './trio-core/contract-core.mjs';
6 import { runIntake } from './intake.mjs';
7 import { planMatrix } from './matrix-planner.mjs';
8 import { validate, CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION } from './governance.mjs';
9 import { ApprovalProvider } from './approval-provider.mjs';
10 
11 const MAX_EDITS = 3;
12 
13 /**
14  * Validates the state machine preconditions to reach execution.
15  * Both gate records must exist, hashes must match the actual artifacts, and decisions must be APPROVE.
16  * @param {string} runDir
17  * @param {string} triageHash 
18  * @param {string} planHash 
19  */
20 export function validateExecutionState(runDir, triageHash, planHash) {
21   const gate1Path = path.join(runDir, 'gate1-record.json');
22   const gate2Path = path.join(runDir, 'gate2-record.json');
23 
24   if (!fs.existsSync(gate1Path)) throw new HaltError('Execution blocked: Gate 1 record missing');
25   if (!fs.existsSync(gate2Path)) throw new HaltError('Execution blocked: Gate 2 record missing');
26 
27   const gate1 = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(gate1Path, 'utf8'));
28   const gate2 = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(gate2Path, 'utf8'));
29 
30   if (gate1.triageHash !== triageHash) {
31     throw new HaltError('Execution blocked: Gate 1 approval not bound to current triage artifact hash');
32   }
33   if (gate2.planHash !== planHash) {
34     throw new HaltError('Execution blocked: Gate 2 approval not bound to current plan artifact hash');
35   }
36 
37   if (gate1.gate1Decision !== 'APPROVE') {
38     throw new HaltError(`Execution blocked: Gate 1 decision is ${gate1.gate1Decision}, expected APPROVE`);
39   }
40   if (gate2.gate2Decision !== 'APPROVE') {
41     throw new HaltError(`Execution blocked: Gate 2 decision is ${gate2.gate2Decision}, expected APPROVE`);
42   }
43   
44   return true;
45 }
46 
47 /**
48  * Runs the two-gate process.
49  */
50 export async function runTwoGateMachine(inputs, { runDir, promptGate1, promptGate2, maxEdits = MAX_EDITS, lockedGovernorOutput = { hash: 'mock-hash' }, skill = 'researchPrime', onEditedScope, onEditedPlan, approvalProvider, buildPlan } = {}) {
51   let providerIdentity = 'TTY';
52   if (approvalProvider) {
53     providerIdentity = approvalProvider.authorize();
54   }
55 
56   // If non-interactive provider, auto-approve
57   if (providerIdentity !== 'TTY') {
58     promptGate1 = async () => 'APPROVE';
59     promptGate2 = async () => 'APPROVE';
60   }
61 
62   try {
63     let triageResult;
64     let gate1Edits = 0;
65     
66     // GATE 1
67     while (true) {
68       triageResult = await runIntake(inputs, { runDir, promptHuman: promptGate1 });
69       if (triageResult.decision === 'APPROVE') {
70         break;
71       } else if (triageResult.decision === 'EDIT') {
72         gate1Edits++;
73         if (gate1Edits > maxEdits) throw new HaltError(`Run halted at Gate 1: exceeded max EDIT cycles (${maxEdits})`);
74         if (onEditedScope) inputs = await onEditedScope(inputs);
75         continue;
76       } else {
77         // Should not be reached because runIntake throws on ABORT, but added for safety
78         throw new HaltError(`Run halted at Gate 1 with decision ${triageResult.decision}`);
79       }
80     }
81 
82     // GATE 2
83     let gate2Edits = 0;
84     let planHash;
85     let gate2Decision;
86     
87     while (true) {
88       // The artifact the human approves at Gate 2. Default = the generic deterministic
89       // scope/evidence/adversarial/synthesis matrix (back-compat). A real researchPrime run
90       // injects `buildPlan` (see bin/plan-gate.mjs) so Gate 2 approves the ACTUAL Phase-1
91       // research plan — AXIS / candidate branches / stakes vector / foresight receipt — not
92       // the boilerplate matrix. `buildPlan` MUST be a pure function of `inputs` so the same
93       // inputs serialize to the same bytes and therefore the same planHash (EDIT re-hash + replay).
94       const plan = buildPlan
95         ? buildPlan({ inputs })
96         : planMatrix({ objective: inputs.query || inputs.objective || 'default objective' });
97       const planStr = JSON.stringify(plan, null, 2);
98       planHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(planStr).digest('hex');
99       const planPath = path.join(runDir, `plan-${planHash}.json`);
100       
101       fs.writeFileSync(planPath, planStr, 'utf8');
102 
103       if (promptGate2) {
104         gate2Decision = await promptGate2({ planPath, planHash, plan });
105       } else {
106         gate2Decision = 'APPROVE';
107       }
108 
109       fs.writeFileSync(path.join(runDir, 'gate2-record.json'), JSON.stringify({
110         planHash,
111         gate2Decision
112       }, null, 2), 'utf8');
113 
114       if (gate2Decision === 'APPROVE') {
115         break;
116       } else if (gate2Decision === 'EDIT') {
117         gate2Edits++;
118         if (gate2Edits > maxEdits) throw new HaltError(`Run halted at Gate 2: exceeded max EDIT cycles (${maxEdits})`);
119         if (onEditedPlan) inputs = await onEditedPlan(inputs);
120         continue;
121       } else if (gate2Decision === 'ABORT') {
122         throw new HaltError(`Run halted at Gate 2 with decision ABORT (Artifact: ${planHash})`);
123       } else {
124         throw new HaltError(`Run halted at Gate 2 with decision ${gate2Decision}`);
125       }
126     }
127 
128     // Validate state machine reaches execution
129     validateExecutionState(runDir, triageResult.triageHash, planHash);
130 
131     if (approvalProvider) {
132       approvalProvider.validateReplayBinding(triageResult.triageHash, planHash);
133     }
134 
135     // Emit canonical governance record
136     const governanceRecord = {
137       schemaVersion: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
138       triageHash: triageResult.triageHash,
139       gate1Decision: triageResult.decision,
140       planHash: planHash,
141       gate2Decision: gate2Decision,
142       lockedGovernorOutput: lockedGovernorOutput,
143       hostApprovalProvider: providerIdentity,
144       skill: skill
145     };
146 
147     validate(governanceRecord);
148 
149     const govPath = path.join(runDir, 'governance.json');
150     fs.writeFileSync(govPath, JSON.stringify(governanceRecord, null, 2), 'utf8');
151 
152     return { triageHash: triageResult.triageHash, planHash, governanceRecord };
153   } catch (err) {
154     if (err instanceof HaltError || err.name === 'HaltError') {
155       const haltRecord = {
156         status: 'HALTED',
157         reason: err.message,
158         timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
159       };
160       fs.writeFileSync(path.join(runDir, 'HALT-RECORD.json'), JSON.stringify(haltRecord, null, 2), 'utf8');
161     }
162     throw err;
163   }
164 }
